type: Design specification only; not executable data preparation or a frozen fitting protocol.
forecast_unit: h-th future observed target quote (h in {1,5,20}); q is current observed target quote date.

observations_available.no_prior_donor: Mask absent; do not replace age with zero or create an observation

daily_state_order: Start each date q from shared history containing only source events dated <q.
For a forecast of target A on q, create its target view and assimilate only own A quote dated q.
Emit every required event-horizon prediction from that target view without knowing future event times.
Other targets on q use their own analogous views from the pre-date state.
Only after all target forecasts for q are defined may q events join shared history for later dates.
normalization: Fit only on training inputs admitted by this same information rule; no full-file mean, scale, missingness or calendar summary.
training_label_maturity: Every component of a training H20 label must be realized before its training cutoff; applicable support/purge details require a new frozen experiment protocol.
target_time_warning: Sampling a continuous forecast at the realized future event date is a different estimand from issuing an event-index H20 vector at q unless those future dates were demonstrably known and separately authorized.
publication_vintage_limit: Strict date filtering does not authenticate original publication timestamps, revisions or time zones.
future_synthetic_checks_not_run: Changing any same-day or future donor value does not alter target q prediction.
Within-day donor row permutation does not change admissible inputs.
Duplicate source identity is not assimilated twice.
No prior donor produces explicit missingness.
No future target observation date appears in the feature record.
Every training vector uses fully mature labels and training-only scaling.
